children: "In their rate filings, insurers point to a higher-than-usual increase in the underlying cost of care, which is not unique to the ACA Marketplaces; some employer plans have also seen steep cost increases," KFF says.

The organization added that ACA enrollment declined in 2026 as enhanced income tax credits expired. Those with incomes above 400% of the federal poverty level may face difficulty getting coverage in 2027 as they no longer qualify for premium tax credits and must pay the full cost, KFF noted.

Health insurance premiums on state marketplaces will increase by an average of 13% for silver tier plans, according to a new analysis.
Insurers had proposed an average 15% hike.

In states that run their marketplaces, the silver benchmark premium will rise an average of 16%, while in states where it is federally operated, the increase is 11%, the health policy organization KFF found.
Last year, the overall hike was 26%

title: ACA marketplace premiums rising by 13% in 2027
